name: 0.08mm Glass Clear @Solder
notes: Surface-finish variant of 0.12mm Clear @Solder. Bulk clarity settings are identical - 1 wall, no shells, 100% aligned rectilinear infill, 0.5 line widths, 15 mm/s walls, 0% fan. THE ONLY CHANGE IS LAYER HEIGHT 0.08 INSTEAD OF 0.12. The ridge left on a vertical or curved wall is a function of layer height, so a third off the layer height is a third off the ridge depth that scatters light at a glancing angle. It does not make the part any clearer through its bulk; it makes the outside of it less matte. Cost is print time: 1.5x the layer count of 0.12mm Clear @Solder, on a profile that is already slow at 15 mm/s. Use it for parts judged on how they look, not parts judged on how much light passes through. Everything else that governs clarity is unchanged and the same preconditions apply: dry the spool - a damp spool cannot print clear or glossy at any setting. Pair with Numakers PETG-HS Clear @Solder; the fan and flow values that make this work are filament-level.
